html:
The Wakabunga are an Aboriginal Australian people of northwest Queensland, in the country south of the Gulf of Carpentaria, between the Gregory and Leichhardt rivers.

Very little is recorded about them. Their neighbours on the map were the Mayi-Kutuna, Nguburinji, Wakaya and Mingin. Like others of the Gulf, they lost their country to cattle stations from the 1860s and 1870s.
sum: The Wakabunga are an Aboriginal Australian people of northwest Queensland, in the country south of the Gulf of Carpentaria, between the Gregory and Leichhardt rivers.
